entries:
The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of the Fae. May you find them friends in times of need.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是妖精的符文。愿你在需要之时，能找到待你如友的它们。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of Darkness. May you shelter from the suns rays.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是黑暗的符文。愿你能避开烈日的灼烧。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of Light. May the sun illuminate the world.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是光明符文。愿太阳照亮世界。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of Absence. What you seek must not be present.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是空缺的符文。你所寻之物必不在此。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Doorway marks reveal gates of much importance, whether seen or unseen.

石上刻着这样的话：

门径标记会揭示极为重要的门户，无论看得见，还是看不见。
Make honor for king. Respect. Reverent.
Gouraah! Enter peace. No make fight.
古拉赫！进来，和平。不要斗。

Danger: Unstable Ground.
     Use other entrance.

危险：地面不稳。
     请走另一个入口。
Make honor for king. Respect. Reverent.
Gouraah! Enter peace. No make fight.
古拉赫！进来，和平。不要斗。
Me too. It's been boring ever since the gate was sealed.
我也想听。大门封死之后，日子就无聊透了。
This stone is too damaged to make out the inscription.
这块石头损坏得太严重，已经辨认不出刻文。
Day and night, I watch this passage.
日日夜夜，我都守着这条通道。
Callor is the only one who ever goes this way.
只有卡洛尔会从这边走。
It is such an honor to watch Callor work.
看卡洛尔干活真是一种荣幸。
He's dug up enough pottery to open a studio.
他挖出的陶器都够开一间作坊了。
You should see the beautiful collection he has made.
你真该看看他攒下的收藏，美极了。
It is truly stunning in scope.
These are fragments of people's lives.
这些是他人生活的碎片。
You're going to break them, aren't you?
你会把它们打碎的，对吧？

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Pointer marks usually indicate that you should look at, or for something.

石上刻着这样的话：

指示标记通常表示：你应当看向某物，或寻找某物。
It's good to see someone that hasn't lost their mind.
见到一个还没疯的人，真好。
We don't get many visitors anymore.
我们如今没什么访客了。
That's why I have a pet rat.
所以我才养了只宠物鼠。
He fell over the ledge, though.
这个房间算比较安静的。
Sometimes though, I swear that I can hear a voice coming from that odd door.
不过有时候，我发誓那扇怪门后面传来说话声。
The others like to mess with me.
One time, they started whispering to let them out, and wouldn't stop.
有一次，他们一直在低声念着「放我们出去」，停都停不下来。
For once I'd like to get duty on the other side.
真希望哪次能轮到我去另一头站岗。
I won't fall over the edge, I swear.
我发誓，我不会掉下崖边的。
I only slipped that one time.
Ok, twice. But, that was it.
Be quiet in the library. Unless monsters are attacking. Then be very loud.
在图书馆内请保持安静。除非有怪物来袭，那时请尽情喧哗。
The Monster Summoner is dangerous. Use at your own risk.
怪物召唤器十分危险。使用后果自负。
No drinks beyond this point! You know who you are.
此线之外禁止饮酒！谁干的自己清楚。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Trigger marks are associated with something that can be activated, like a switch or pressure plate.

石上刻着这样的话：

触发标记与某个可以激活的东西相关，例如开关或压力板。
I saw him single-handedly hold the southern gate.
我亲眼见过他单枪匹马守住南门。
I once saw him catch an arrow with his teeth.
我有次见他用牙齿接住了一支箭。
He won a staring contest with an occulant.
他和一只视者对视，赢了。
He once used a mimic as a stool to get flour off the top shelf.
他曾把一只宝箱怪当凳子，去够架子顶上的面粉。
I hear he forced a giant spider to weave him a hammock.
听说他逼一只巨蛛给他织了张吊床。
A book tried to eat him once, but he held it down and read the whole thing!
一本书曾想吃掉他，结果被他按住，从头读到了尾！
The shadows flee from torchlight, but he caught them once.
影子见了火光就跑，可他曾抓住过一个。
He bakes a mean apple pie.
守卫的差事永远没个完。
Before the gate was sealed we had to fight off monsters constantly.
大门封死之前，我们得一刻不停地打退怪物。
My favorite trick was to trip them over the ledge.
我最爱的招数是把它们绊下崖边。
It doesn't work so well when they can fly.
可惜对方会飞时就不太好使了。
Or a body that my weapon passes straight through.
再或者，武器会直接穿过它的身体。
Basically, my tripping tactic rarely works.
总而言之，我的绊人战术很少奏效。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Path marks always indicate a path to be followed.

石上刻着这样的话：

路径标记总是表示一条当行之路。
We have to function as a whole, not individuals.
我们是一个整体，不是一个个个体。
It is a really good name though.
不过，这名字真的很好听。
I'm named after my great grandnephew's cat.
这名字取自曾侄孙的猫。
I bet you really want to know.
There's no other name like it.
再没有别的名字像它了。
It's kind of a family name.
Fine, I'll tell you. It's "Heyou". I told you it was great.
好吧，就告诉你。叫「黑尤」。我就说很棒吧。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Whisper marks indicate that a spoken word is being requested.

石上刻着这样的话：

低语标记表示此处需要念出一个词。
This is the way to the southern gate.
Do I get nervous being so close to the edge?
离崖边这么近，我会紧张吗？
Sure, but it can't be that deep.
当然会，不过它不可能有多深。
I hear noises down there all the time.
Like that rat I kicked off once.
就像那只被我踢下去的老鼠。
As it fell, I thought I spotted a collar.
它掉下去的时候，我好像看见它戴着项圈。
We dont need rats in here anyways.
反正我们这儿也不需要老鼠。
We have a limited food supply, you know.
你也知道，我们的食物是有限的。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Item marks are always associated with hidden objects. Sometimes they are buried, but other times they are merely obscured.

石上刻着这样的话：

物品标记总与隐藏之物相关。有时它们被埋在地下，有时只是被遮蔽了。

Training Hall
Do not interfere with training.

训练堂
不得干扰训练。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Phase marks indicate the presence of something arcane or foreign.

石上刻着这样的话：

相位标记表示此处存在奥术或异界之物。
I dropped a sandwich over the edge once.
我有次把一块三明治掉下了崖边。
I like to think it's still falling to this day.
我宁愿相信它到今天还在往下掉。
Make sure not to touch the device without talking to Corvin.
未经科尔文许可，千万别碰那台装置。
I won't help you either way.
It's guard stuff. You wouldn't understand.
这是守卫的事。你不会懂的。
No running in the grand hall!

The stone is inscribed with these words:

Barrier marks indicate some sort of impassible, arcane wall.

石上刻着这样的话：

屏障标记表示某种无法逾越的奥术之墙。
Drag the dog onto into the top slot on the right bar. When he is the party leader you can use his Leader Ability (blue diamond button) by this door to dig and find a key.
把狗狗拖到右侧栏最上方的槽位。当它成为队伍领队时，即可在这扇门旁使用它的领队能力（蓝色菱形按钮）挖掘，找到钥匙。

You will need a spell to escape.
Search for a Spellbook.
Equip it in your inventory.
Cast the spell using the menu buttons above.

你需要一个法术才能脱身。
去寻找一本法术书。
在物品栏中装备它。
用上方的菜单按钮施放该法术。

E: Emerisk
W: Nalwin
NW: Ambrost Forest

东：埃梅里斯克
西：纳尔温
西北：安布罗斯特森林
I have a very nice view of the cattle.
我这儿看牛的视野非常好。
Believe it or not, they can be quite relaxing.
信不信由你，牛能让人相当放松。
It's the gentle lowing. The sound of moos.
You know, a moo moo here.

东：埃梅里斯克
西：纳尔温
I am very glad you came to visit me here.
你能来这儿看我，我真高兴。
It can get lonely on the edge.
I haven't seen anything suspicious in a long time.
我已经很久没见到可疑的东西了。
你们这些人看着就挺可疑的。
Sometimes, I wish I could go adventuring.
有时候，我真希望能去冒险。
我能加入你们的队伍吗？
Nevermind... my wife would kill me.
算了……我老婆会杀了我的。
If I had a wife, that is.
This job is a lot easier than farming.
这活儿比种地轻松多了。
Old man Gyffard is always trying to recruit me.
吉法德老头总想拉我入伙。
I wouldn't give this job up for anything.
这份工作我说什么都不换。
I get to view the rolling hills and leafy groves.
我能看着连绵的丘陵与繁茂的树林。
Well, I used to, until this fog rolled in.
好吧，以前能看到，直到这片迷雾漫了过来。
The job is still nice though.
不过这活儿还是挺好的。
I don't even need to sleep.
Actually, nobody does anymore, but they still do it out of routine.
其实大家都不需要了，只是习惯使然还在睡。
I'm making killer overtime pay working 24 hours a day.
我一天干 24 小时，加班费拿到手软。
I'll retire one day and live my dream of being a guard for free!
等我哪天退休，就去圆我的梦：免费当守卫！

Rafficus Renault
His temper was short
His reign shorter

Rafficus Renault
脾气很短
在位更短

Patrick Klem
Saw all the possible endings
Except for this one

Patrick Klem
见过所有可能的结局
唯独没见过这一个

Archeas Swane
Small gravestone
Big life

Archeas Swane
小小的墓碑
大大的人生
Don't even try to imagine them.
I've never seen such angry creatures.
我从未见过这么愤怒的生物。
Now please, let me finish this salted pork in peace.
现在行行好，让我安安静静吃完这块咸猪肉。

Cobon Warde
Did not plan on dying
Never was good at planning

Cobon Warde
没打算过要死
也从来都不擅长计划

Innes Redmund
Watcher of the Wyld

Innes Redmund
荒野的守望者

Clumsy Anned
Dropped a lantern in a shed
Now he is dead

Clumsy Anned
在棚屋里掉了盏提灯
然后他就没有了性命

William Bitler
A glass full of passion
Spilled at the wrong time

William Bitler
一杯盛满热忱
却在错误的时候倾洒

西：埃梅里斯克
东：波特……
I used to wander the rocky hills as a lad.
我年轻时常常在乱石山岗间游荡。
There was fog then too. Once, I fell into a hole because of some dumb cat.
那时也有迷雾。有一次，一只蠢猫害我掉进了洞里。
Luckily, I made it back to town and resumed my life.
幸好我回到了镇上，继续过我的日子。
Can you imagine if I had gotten stuck in that cave?
你能想象我要是困在那个洞里会怎样吗？
Anyways, the western road here is safe.
总之，这边的西路是安全的。
I always get those two mixed up.
It doesn't matter really, as long as nothing gets past me.
其实也无所谓，只要没有东西能过我这关。
Something did get past me once.
不过有一次确实有东西过去了。
But nothing ever came of it, so all is well that ends well, right?
但后来什么也没发生。结局圆满，那就一切都好，对吧？

Yorhan Fennegar
Unfortunate enough to be the messenger

Yorhan Fennegar
倒霉到当了信使

Roanold Hayfest
He was a butcher

Six feet tall,
Now six feet under

曾身高六尺，
如今长眠六尺之下

Joel Haftel
A pathfinder
But all trails led here

Joel Haftel
一名探路者
可所有小径都通向这里

Artzeina Wylde
Took care of the sick
Until they took care of her

Artzeina Wylde
悉心照料病人
直到轮到他们照料她

Mad man Atticus Ley
Shouted his name at the arches
Even in death you can hear him say
Atticus as he marches

疯子 Atticus·莱伊
曾在拱门下呼喊自己的名字
就连死后也能听见他
一路行进，一路念着：Atticus

Joid Renault
His hand was driven by honor
His hand was stayed by mercy
His hands were open for those in need

Joid Renault
他的手由荣耀驱使
他的手因仁慈而停
他的双手总为需要之人敞开

Hammet and Tulia Gyffard
Cropmasters and confidants

Hammet and Tulia Gyffard
农事总管与知己
We see many people wander out of the fog.
我们见过许多人从迷雾里游荡出来。
I wonder where they came from.
真不知道他们从哪儿来。
This is the only town in the world, so maybe they came from here.
这世上只有这一座镇子，所以他们多半是从这儿出去的。
Left from the top, wandered for a bit, and came back here.
从上面离开，在外游荡一阵，又回到了这里。
I'm glad to be here and not in the fog.
我很庆幸在这儿，而不在迷雾里。
A guard wandered into the fog once, and forgot all kinds of things.
有名守卫曾走进迷雾，忘掉了各种各样的事。
The mayor says not to, and he's probably right.
市长说别进去，他大概是对的。
But, sometimes curiosity just gets the best of you.
可有时候，好奇心就是会战胜理智。
Guard duty isn't the most exciting job.
站岗并不是最刺激的工作。

Thought he was tough
Ended up mostly armless

自以为刀枪不入
最后落得「无臂」一生

Bertrannus Covey
Said his back was killing him
But nobody believed

Bertrannus Covey
总说自己的背要命
可没有人相信

北：埃梅里斯克
南：海加德

Apocalypstic
Found many spelling errors
But coudln't fix this one

Apocalypstic
找出过许多拼写错误
却改不了自己这块

Josef Ingram
Poorer than dirt
Richer than most

Josef Ingram
比尘土更穷
比多数人更富有

Nameless Rider
Over river and through woods
The horse did drag him

Nameless Rider
翻过河川，穿过林地
是马把他拖了一路
Do you ever get the feeling something is watching you?
你有过被什么东西注视着的感觉吗？
That's the life of a guard I guess.
守卫的生活就是这样吧。
Who wouldn't want to look at my fancy getup.
谁会不想看看我这身漂亮行头呢？
And freeze the very air around me.
还会把我周围的空气冻住。
And claw its way into my mind.
还会用爪子硬挤进我的脑子。
And whisper softly of my doom.
还会轻声低语我的厄运。
Ok yeah, when I say it out loud it sounds pretty bad.
好吧，是啊，说出口之后听着是挺糟的。

Yuvo and Greama Clere
Finest bakers in the world

Yuvo and Greama Clere
世上最好的面包师

lv6#22544/plaqueMessage
Stop standing on me
别踩在我身上

Everey Cole
Loved skipping stones
But could not skip this one

Everey Cole
最爱打水漂
这一劫却漂不过去

Elendor
Met his end in the middle

Elendor
在半路上迎来了尽头

Hissander and Leanna Meyard
Lost to the river

Hissander and Leanna Meyard
被河水永远带走

Danny Huynh
Fought the good fight
But his strength did wane

Danny Huynh
打了一场好仗
无奈力气用尽

Jourdain Hayfest
Fine Cook
Finer Friend

Jourdain Hayfest
好厨子
更好的朋友

Sabin Teubner
Crushed by the weight of lyfe

Sabin Teubner
被 Lyfe 的重量压垮
还是说，这边其实是东边？
The view from up here is nice.
I can see any threat coming from way up here.
站在这儿，远远就能看见任何威胁靠近。
Well, I could, if my visor wasn't so small.
唉，本来能看见的，可惜我的面甲太小了。
I should probably get back to work.
YOU, should probably get back to work.
而你，大概也该回去干活了。

Naira Gyffard
Read many books
But not the final chapter

Naira Gyffard
读了无数本书
却没能读到最后一章

Truthless Dann
Even in death
Here he lies

Truthless Dann
即便是死后
他也依然长眠于此

Essau Thorp
Nothing is written in stone

Essau Thorp
没有什么是刻在石头上的

Gyrard Beltran
Stood determined and steadfast
Until the cart ran him over

Gyrard Beltran
坚定不屈地站着
直到马车从他身上碾过

Raine and Forissa Meyard
Friends forever

Raine and Forissa Meyard
永远的朋友

无名者
曾以勇气而战

Bannette Redmund
Art was her life
And her life was art

Bannette Redmund
艺术是她的生命
她的生命即艺术

Tommes Lyfe
Trying to climb out of a well
Onto poor Sabin he fell

Tommes Lyfe
试图爬出井口
却砸在了可怜的 Sabin 身上
This is the best guard spot in town.
这是全镇最好的守卫岗。
If I get tired I can sit on a bench.
If I get thirsty I can draw from the well.
If I get bored I can think of the horrible sounds I hear coming from the well.
无聊了还可以想想从井里传来的可怕声响。
Far from the fog, and far from danger.
Unless there are evil things that we can't even see.
除非有我们根本看不见的邪恶之物。
They could walk right past me and I would never know.
它们可以从我身边走过，而我永远都不会知道。
I have a wild imagination, right?
我的想象力可真丰富，对吧？
That's why I was fired from my last job.
所以上一份工作把我开除了。

Okannus Vawdrey
His life was but a thread in the great tapestry

Okannus Vawdrey
他的一生只是巨幅织锦中的一根丝线

The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of Miala. May she light your way on darkest paths.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是米亚拉的符文。愿她在至暗之路上为你照亮前行。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of Gammon. May he empower you in all ways.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是加蒙的符文。愿他在各方各面赐你力量。

The stone is inscribed with these words:

This is the rune of Tethrys. May he hide your path from those that seek you harm.

石上刻着这样的话：

这是泰丝瑞斯的符文。愿他向图谋害你之人隐去你的行踪。
